subject.title: improve(diagnostics): surface run startup phases as session-correlated events

question: Should embedded-runner execution phases become a stable public `DiagnosticEventPayload` and plugin SDK contract, rather than remaining a privileged internal diagnostic signal?
rationale: The implementation is additive, but expanding the discriminated plugin event union establishes compatibility expectations for external consumers that code review and green CI cannot decide.

options.title: Approve the public event
options.body: Adopt `run.execution_phase` as a stable typed plugin contract after rebase and real-behavior proof.

options.title: Keep phases privileged
options.body: Retain the instrumentation for bundled internal diagnostics but avoid exposing a new stable plugin SDK event variant.

options.title: Pause the API expansion
options.body: Keep the issue and PR open until the diagnostics event-versioning or compatibility policy is clarified.

recommendation.title: Approve the public event
recommendation.body: Adopt `run.execution_phase` as a stable typed plugin contract after rebase and real-behavior proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent work owns the trusted diagnostic subscription and plugin SDK exposure boundary most directly affected by this choice.
